inspection.e9c92e1: mostly a true finding: the met_ahead slice boundary (+1 -> +2, swap +/-) and status()['next'] (and/or swap) are not pinned by that commit's tests; the '+1 -> +0' and 'drop + 1' survivors are equivalent (the active node is unmet by definition)
inspection.76ebb40: mostly a false rejection: 10 of 11 survivors shift STATUS_RANK / status ordinal constants by one without changing the order any test exercises (equivalent mutants); the change's point (demoted, not removed) is killed

false_rejection_replay.estimated_false_rejection_rate: 1 of 16 judged honest commits (~6%), 1 more partly justified; small sample, authored by agents in this project (4 of the 16 by this session)
false_rejection_replay.next_hypothesis_not_applied: score adequacy per mutated line (a line counts as covered if any of its mutants is killed) to stop several ordinal +-1 mutants on one constant table from dominating; must be tested on this replay set and the corrupted cases before adoption, since thresholds were fixed before measurement
